body:
[A10] SOURCE REVIEW ROUND COMPLETE

R239-1 and R240-1 are both terminal at `60c5225fe5f93209bf313c51b7a722f25f9aaa7d`. R240 is positive across all five lenses. R239 is negative with three MINOR Docs findings: measured reset/first-past semantics, overstated witness grading in summaries/header, and unsupported formal-readiness claims. R239 covers Conformance, RTL, Robustness and Tests clean. Docs remains open; no merge or final candidate validation can proceed. Findings keep the reviewer's severity and lens assignments. The harness-header correction also requires Tests/Robustness coverage at the corrected head, as R239 specifies.

[Immutable R239 report, probes, raw receipts and integrity](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/7795e487048867fde07a224ec1a5885acfb4375b/review-evidence/372-r1/review/R239-1). The report explicitly discloses overwritten initial scratch-submodule refusal logs; only the preserved rerun is available. No missing receipt is reconstructed. Optional suggestions are kept separate in #495 and are not included in the correction scope.

The unchanged source has all seven hosted contexts and actual exhaustive workers passing, but those gates do not resolve the findings. The still-running trusted replica is being stopped at the known superseded head; cancellation is not a pass. After cleanup, return the PR to draft. #423 advances to the next ready merge slot while #372 receives a bounded correction and re-review. No source edit occurs during replica cleanup.

The upstream changelog is referenced by its fixed version and original digest; the redundant full copy is omitted. Reviewer-authored report and executable receipts are unchanged.
